falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically features lower highs and failed breakouts; a clean breakout above the August 2024 resistance zone invalidates the structural similarity and suggests accumulation rather than distribution

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern's bottom formation requires sustained volatility elevation; sustained VIX compression would signal complacency inconsistent with capitulation/reversal dynamics, breaking the fear-to-relief arc

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.85% while S&P 500 simultaneously rises more than 2% from current levels
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a growth-scare/rate-cut bid rather than the stagflationary or credit-stress bottoming environment characteristic of the August 2024 pattern, where yields and equities moved in tighter correlation

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
